title: The 31 Aug 2026 correction added a supersession banner to four BMP cards and, by its own declared scope, left "every BMP5 technique block deliberately untouched". Three of the four therefore went on teaching in their body and Numbers layers that BMP5 is the current active edition - contradicting the banner two screens above. This closes that, plus the security and provenance findings in the same four cards.
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Tranche 4 findings P1-03 to P1-08, P1-10, P1-11, P1-13 to P1-16, P1-18, P1-19, with coupled P2-06, P2-13, P2-14, P2-15, P2-16, P2-17, P2-18.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD. BMP Maritime Security primary bytes are now held for the first time, and every migrated proposition is quoted from them rather than adjudicated.
authority:
BMP Maritime Security, 1st Edition 2025 as updated June 2026, held and read. Its version-control table gives Edition "First" for BOTH rows, which is primary proof there is no second edition. Threat-based muster verbatim: locations "will vary depending on the threat, i.e. threat from piracy (citadel), threat from WBIED/UAV (above waterline)"; a security muster point's "location should be above the waterline if there's a risk of hull breach"; a citadel "should accommodate the entire crew and any extra staff for 3-5 days". Escape routes: where a door on an escape route is locked, "it is essential a means of opening the door from the inside is available". Illegal-boarding response: "increase to maximum to open the distance" and "steer straight". SOLAS Consolidated Edition 2024 for II-2/10.2.1.6, II-2/13.4.2.1 and XI-2/8. ISM Code A.741(18) as amended by MSC.273(85) for 5.1.5 and 12.1.

SOURCES RELIED ON: SRC-BMPMS-2026, SRC-BMPMS-2025, SRC-SOLAS-CONSOLIDATED-2024, SRC-ISMCODE-CONSOLIDATED.

note:
SCOPE. The four selected cards. Occurrences of "BMP5" were classified, not replaced mechanically: question stems and the supersession banners were retained as historical/pedagogical (classes B and C) and only current-authority teaching was migrated (class A), with the one unverifiable section-number citation rewritten against current BMP MS concept rather than given an invented replacement number (class D). Company claims elsewhere in QB4_B.html and the "Compiled by ... Maersk A/S" byline are authorship attribution and were NOT touched.

CARRIED FORWARD (recorded, not swept): BMP5 is still presented without a supersession banner at meoclass1/QB1_F.html#q10 and in meoclass1/QB5_B_CheatSheet.html - same defect family, outside the four cards the brief named. | The question stems of QB4_B#q16 ("BMP5") and QB9_B#q5 (an authoring rubric rather than a question) were deliberately left alone: a stem change moves derived surfaces and must be scoped separately. | MSC.1/Circ.1606 was never identified.
